verdict.rationale: Mercury explicitly markets granular user permissions and one-click approval by designated teammates (e.g., accountants), directly matching the story, and this is corroborated by long-term customer usage of granular controls across accounts/cards. However, evidence lacks detailed documentation of the actual approval-permission configuration UI/workflow beyond marketing copy. Missing for 10: detailed admin-facing docs or screenshots of the approval-permission setup flow, independent confirmation of one-click send-payment experience by a non-owner approver.
